title: Luck Is Not Skill: When Do Paired Rollouts Help Group-Relative RL of LLM Agents?
abstract: arXiv:2609.24144v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Group-relative reinforcement learning compares rollouts of the same prompt, but independent environment noise can obscure these comparisons. We study paired rollouts, which share an event-keyed noise schedule within each group while preserving each rollout's marginal distribution. Pairing removes the between-schedule component of reward-contrast variance, but need not reduce gradient variance. For one-sided grader noise, we derive an exact condition for reduction and give a counterexample in which reward contrasts improve while gradient variance increases. A controlled study trains a 2B tool-use agent under tool faults and grader flips, with three seeds per design. The protocol was registered with a disclosed, previously completed pilot. Under tool faults, pairing improves final noisy-test success by +5.1 percentage points on average, with all three seed differences positive, but misses the registered learning-curve criterion. translated_title: 运气不是技能：成对采样何时有助于LLM智能体的组相对强化学习？
translated_abstract: 组相对强化学习通过比较同一提示下的多次采样来进行学习，但独立的环境噪声可能会掩盖这些比较。我们研究了成对采样，它在每个组内共享一个基于事件键控的噪声调度，同时保持每次采样的边际分布不变。配对消除了奖励对比方差中的调度间成分，但不一定会降低梯度方差。对于单侧评分器噪声，我们推导出了方差降低的精确条件，并给出了一个反例：奖励对比得到改善的同时梯度方差反而增加。一项受控研究在工具故障和评分器翻转的条件下训练了一个2B参数的工具使用智能体，每种设计使用三个随机种子。该实验方案在公开披露的、预先完成的试点基础上进行了注册。在工具故障条件下，配对平均使最终噪声测试成功率提高5.1个百分点，且三个种子的差异均为正，但未达到注册的学习曲线标准。摘要在此处被截断。
tldr: 本文从理论上推导了成对采样降低组相对强化学习梯度方差的精确条件并给出反例，实验证明配对采样在工具故障环境下平均提升2B工具使用智能体最终成功率5.1个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper derives an exact condition for when paired rollouts reduce gradient variance in group-relative RL of LLM agents, provides a counterexample, and shows empirically that pairing improves final success by +5.1 percentage points for a 2B tool-use agent under tool faults.
